requirements.text:
WP-024 first supplies the minimal persistence/uniqueness API for `follow_up_obligation`, managed `task`, history/audit/receipt and source-revision changes using the caller's transaction. WP-022 depends on that kernel and owns one finalize/reconcile unit of work: lock meeting/current guest-attendance revision and affected live Persons, compute exact attended identity snapshot/classification, apply approved People attendance progression, create required first-Vision obligations plus evaluation task, record current actual Attendance/snapshot/marker and audit/receipt/material revision atomically. No after-commit task call or stub weakens this boundary. A zero-attendee Vision still produces evaluation work. Missing lead title/account never suppresses obligations; a currently eligible selected assignee or visible Needs owner is required. Durable review includes all generated work; invalid assignment refuses or uses explicitly reviewed unowned result.

Repeat same finalized revision returns original receipt; concurrent calls converge. Late additions/removals/same-count replacements are reconciled by identity and expected revision, not count. Corrected first-Vision eligibility may add/supersede current obligations through a reviewed delta; completed/waived/outcome history survives and no performed work is silently deleted. A removed attendee's unperformed obligation is marked source-corrected/no-longer-applicable with history, not successful completion. Changing current meeting date does not rewrite immutable original follow-up 48 h origin; a correction to an erroneous origin is separately reviewed with old/new metric lineage. Finalization is independent from setting meeting status completed and from practice occurrence completion. Injected failure rolls back marker+attendance effects+obligations+task+audit; response loss returns saved receipt. WP-022 proves its actual kernel consumer before closure, WP-023 later adds outcomes/contact/ownership projections; WP-056 is additional whole-target regression.

requirements.text: Each generated first-Vision obligation has immutable tenant/origin meeting/Person/kind identity and captured resolved originating Instant, LocalDate/zone/formula version, applicability snapshot, assignment and current state/revision. Two distinct same-day meetings never collapse through person/day uniqueness. Source edits/task relation edits/soft deletion/waiver cannot bypass obligation identity or cause regeneration. Due day is originating meeting local date+2 calendar days; the exact 48 elapsed-hour measurement is separate and uses the actual successful originating-task completion Instant against the captured actual originating-occurrence Instant. At a frozen asOf, pending obligations younger than 48 hours are excluded until mature; mature pending obligations are measured misses. A valid successful completion at or after origin and at or before origin+48 elapsed hours enters as an early success. Future actual origins/completions or pre-origin completions are invalid and excluded; waiver is separately excluded. Database createdAt or recordedAt may be later than the actual historical event and never invalidates truthful backdated occurrence/completion evidence. Retiring a genuine originating meeting preserves its obligation and performed history; voiding an invalid origin uses reviewed correction lineage. Untraceable/manual follow-up lacks that measurement lineage and is excluded/Unknown, never guessed. Task-fulfillment timeliness requires an attributable actual originating-task completion event with its typed human follow-up outcome; a raw completed checkbox or provider acceptance alone is insufficient. Contacted, attempted_no_contact, or administrative_completion may fulfill that task; attempted/admin completion never earns actual-contact credit. Confirmed actual-contact count/freshness uses only contacted occurredAt, and absent supported contact evidence stays Unknown. Report task fulfillment and confirmed contact separately. no_longer_needed closes without successful-completion credit and permanently suppresses replay regeneration. Reopening/correcting changes effective current results with attributable history, preserving old receipt/assessment lineage. A post-launch Sunday 48 h measure with no approved origin is unmeasured/Unknown; prelaunch Vision success is never relabelled and no services module is invented.

requirements.text: `follow_up_outcome` records contacted|attempted_no_contact|administrative_completion|no_longer_needed, actual occurredAt, immutable recordedAt/original actor, operation/obligation/task/person links and expected revision. Explicit human-confirmed contacted alone advances actual-contact freshness using occurredAt; email sent/open/click, task administrative completion, attempt or waiver supplies no contact. A contacted outcome with future/invalid time is rejected; historical late entry remains its actual occurrence. Contacted may be recorded independently from task completion when truthful, with the distinction shown. Current freshness is maximum valid effective contacted occurrence after corrections/reopen/void; removing erroneous latest evidence reveals earlier valid date rather than retaining a cached false success. Contact log renders a human-contact badge, never email delivered. Correction appends old/new/reason/actor, updates current outcome/contact projection and source revision atomically, does not resend mail or erase original receipt. Notes remain bounded operational records and cannot become private-care/model pastoral inference.
